messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [AUTOPAGER] PagerDuty incident PD-7842 fired -> high 5xx rate on /v1/generate across prod-usw2. Observed 5xx rate 18% over 2m window, baseline 0.3%.

sara: I'm on it — taking lead. grabbing logs now.

mike: saw the alerts, rerouting traffic? any idea region/local?

jordan: metrics show spike concentrated to edge-proxy pool ep-prod-uw2-a. upstreams are returning 502/504. Could be keepalive resets.

sara: ops checklist: 1) confirm customer impact 2) scale fallback pool 3) notify CS if customer-facing. Doing quick impact check. @customer-success can you watch for inbound tickets?

customer-success: watching. no reported customer incidents yet, but some 429s and a couple timeouts noted by a churn telemetry alert.

sara: ok. runbook step: try warming new instances on dedicated pool and enable fallback routing to region eu-west1 for non-EU data while we triage. I'm hitting the autoscale cmd.

ops-bot: runbook action executed: `infra autoscale pool=ep-prod-uw2-b count=+6` (initiated by sara)

mike: pushing canary route: `proxyctl route add /v1/generate -> ep-prod-uw2-b weight=0.2` — verifying.

jordan: logs from edge show repeated `connection reset by peer` from nginx -> upstream timeout 60s. sample:
```
2026-03-15T04:05:12Z ep-proxy-123 nginx: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream
```

sara: good catch. increasing upstream timeout temporarily to 120s for ep-prod-uw2 proxy group.

mike: done. `proxyctl config set ep-prod-uw2 upstream_timeout=120s` (ops-bot confirmed)

ops-bot: change accepted: upstream_timeout=120s (applied to ep-prod-uw2)

jordan: after routing ~20% to ep-prod-uw2-b, 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 7% in 45s. good signal.

sara: can we put a short-term circuit breaker on the problematic backend host set? prefer to isolate bad nodes.

mike: `infra cordon node=ep-backend-77 reason=502-spike` — cordoned.

laura: FYI, I'm drafting a quick customer note template in case CS needs to send; will post.

customer-success: please include impacted endpoints and mitigations, ETA for full resolution.

sara: scaling and cordon held. marking incident status: partial mitigation. next: investigate cause — kernel-level TCP resets? schedule packet capture on node 77.

jordan: capturing pcap now, attaching to the incident channel once done. suspected issue: keepalive connections to model-serving container intermittently closing under high keepalive reuse.

sara: assigning follow-up: jordan to analyze pcap, laura to prepare CS note, mike to monitor for 15m, I'll stay on rotation and escalate to infra if we see regression.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident PD-7842 status updated -> partial_mitigated. Pager duty note added by sara.

sara: quick retrospective action items: add better failure classification for keepalive resets, tune LB keepalive/retry default, create alert for upstream conn-reset spike at 5% threshold.

mike: agreed. creating ticket INFRA-1934 for LB tuning and alerting.

laura: posted customer note draft to #customer-comms (link) — ready for approval.

customer-success: approved, sending now.

sara: great team. I'll keep this open for monitoring 30m then close if stable.

jordan: pcap analysis shows SYN-RST bursts from container runtime, sending dump and a short summary.

sara: thanks — we'll pick up root cause next cadence. closing mitigation loop in 25m if no reoccurrence. :thumbsup:
